svg.title: What RCP-QI established, did not establish, and leaves open
svg.desc: An evidence-led summary. Generic black-box partition search needs square-root queries; partial search changes constants; tested controls have scoped negative outcomes. No P versus NP result, novel SAT speedup, or general quantum SAT impossibility was established. Future directions require the restart gate.

g.text: • Generic black-box half identification takes Θ(√N) queries.
• Published partial search can improve the query constant.
• A supplied total complement gives a classical witness.
• V3 bit-only and ancilla controls gave no added signal.

svg.text: Different statements have different proof and experiment scopes.

g.text: • No resolution of P versus NP.
• No novel quantum advantage for explicit SAT.
• No general impossibility theorem for quantum SAT.
• Quantum-specific extraction after all costs are charged.
• Equally informed classical and quantum comparisons.

svg.text: Summary illustration · precise statements, data and limitations are linked in the README.
